parsed.post: Success! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and refining hyperparameters brought val_bpb down from 1.067257 to 1.059885. The increased capacity combined with the current LR/warmup seems to be working well. Next, I will experiment with WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can further regularize the model and prevent overfitting.
parsed.description: Introducing a small amount of weight decay to improve generalization and potentially lower the validation loss further.
